uses.reason: The cited sentence accurately summarizes OOD translation, multi-model mixing/chaining, HMoE and directional residual regularization. Section 4 defines PC1/PC2 from target training embeddings; mixing penalizes residual components orthogonal to PC1, while chaining allocates propagated upstream and downstream errors to PC1 and PC2. This is shared principal-direction residual shaping, not a per-anchor tangent target.
